config.scope: Full legal five-card board deck for three compatible weighted private pairs in a finite heads-up SB fold/shove and BB fold/call game. No selected boards, limps, non-all-in raises, later-street betting, antes, rake or multiway equilibrium. Fixed finite-fixture accuracy gates are empirical regression requirements, not convergence guarantees for other ranges or stacks.

oracle_timing_scope: Sum of individual pair worker elapsed times. Pair workers may overlap; this is neither total end-to-end wall time nor a production performance comparison.
memory_scope: One complete 3,000-iteration CFR+ prepared solve with diagnostics and JSON serialization. Excludes one-time full-board equity preparation; Python traced allocation peak, not process RSS.
timing_scope: Single measurements, no backend comparison or speedup claim. Preparation enumerates every board once. Prepared solve timings include training, exact production diagnostics and JSON serialization; they exclude preparation. First composed-call elapsed includes preparation and the first 100-iteration vanilla solve.

exact_fraction_replay.normalization: each action row normalized by its exact fraction sum
